Title: Azure Log Analytics is available in West US 2

Body.Content: Azure Log Analytics is now available in the West US 2 region. Azure Log Analytics is part of the Azure Monitor service.  It's used to collect telemetry from a variety of sources worldwide. This update enables workspaces to be created in the West US 2 region, to retain and process data in that region.
